_about: A green card for an asylee or a refugee (src/asylee.py; 8 CFR 209.1, 209.2): the G-28 and the I-485 (Part 2, 3.d), with the proof of the grant on top of the evidence. The asylum approval or the immigration judge's order, or the refugee I-94; then identity, birth and police records. Mailed to the non-family lockbox for the client's state (USCIS's I-485 page, 'Asylum, Refugee, or HRIFA'). No I-765 in the envelope: an asylee's or refugee's work permit is mailed on its own (USCIS's I-765 filing addresses). DRAFT: the attorney approves titles and order.
title: Green card as an asylee or refugee (I-485)

handwork.text: Two identical passport photos; the client's name and A-Number lightly in pencil on the back.
An asylee: Form I-693 (medical exam) in the civil surgeon's sealed envelope (8 CFR 209.2(d)). A refugee: the vaccination record only, unless there were medical grounds at admission (8 CFR 209.1(c)).
An inadmissibility ground (a crime, an immigration violation): a waiver under INA 209(c) is asked for with the I-485 (Form I-602). The attorney decides.

exhibits.title: Proof of asylee or refugee status: the asylum approval, the immigration judge's order granting asylum, or the I-94 showing admission as a refugee
Passport identity page and any U.S. visa
Birth certificate, with certified English translation
Other identity documents: work permit, Social Security card, driver's license
Immigration court documents (the Notice to Appear, the judge's orders)

leave_out.intake_questionnaire: The firm's own intake questionnaire: internal.
leave_out.declaration: The asylum declaration was part of the I-589, not asked for with the I-485.
leave_out.country_conditions: Asylum evidence, not asked for with the I-485.
leave_out.news_article: Asylum evidence, not asked for with the I-485.
leave_out.medical_record: Not asked for with the I-485: the medical exam goes in the civil surgeon's sealed I-693.
leave_out.photograph: Asylum evidence, not asked for with the I-485.
leave_out.sij_order: A state court SIJ order: not part of an asylee's or refugee's I-485. Ask the attorney.
leave_out.i360_approval: An I-360: a different basis for a green card. Ask the attorney which one this filing is.
